professionalSummary.text: Three‑year experienced project coordinator in signalling renewals, adept at maintaining possession plans, schedules, and documentation across multiple sites.
professionalSummary.witness: Three years as project coordinator on a signalling renewals programme for a signalling contractor: the possession plan and the works schedule for three renewal sites were mine to keep current each week from the contractor's reported progress.

experienceHighlights.text: Kept possession plan and works schedule current weekly for three renewal sites, using contractor progress reports.
experienceHighlights.witness: Three years as project coordinator on a signalling renewals programme for a signalling contractor: the possession plan and the works schedule for three renewal sites were mine to keep current each week from the contractor's reported progress.

experienceHighlights.text: Recorded possession briefings and site access permits per programme procedures; audited with zero findings.
experienceHighlights.witness: The possession briefings and the site access permits on the three sites were recorded by me under the programme's procedures; the infrastructure owner audited the records twice and raised no findings.

experienceHighlights.text: Prepared and delivered weekly progress reports to the infrastructure owner's representative, incorporating their comments.
experienceHighlights.witness: The infrastructure owner's representative received my weekly progress report on each site, and the reports with the representative's comments are in the programme folder.

experienceHighlights.text: Tracked equipment deliveries against schedule, resolving supplier queries and flagging items requiring project manager possession decisions.
experienceHighlights.witness: Equipment deliveries were tracked by me against the schedule in the delivery log, which marks the delivery queries I settled with the suppliers and the ones that needed the project manager's possession decision.

experienceHighlights.text: Authored hand‑over notes at each commissioning stage, countersigned by the commissioning engineer.
experienceHighlights.witness: Each commissioning stage on the three sites ended with my hand-over note, countersigned by the commissioning engineer.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Work sample includes a month of possession plan updates, a possession briefing record, a weekly progress report, and a commissioning hand‑over note, with programme folder references for verification.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: a month of possession plan updates, a possession briefing record, a weekly progress report and a commissioning stage hand-over note, with the programme folder references as a verification trail.

skills.text: Project coordination, schedule management, documentation control, stakeholder communication, safety compliance.

evidence.text: Three years as project coordinator on a signalling renewals programme for a signalling contractor: the possession plan and the works schedule for three renewal sites were mine to keep current each week from the contractor's reported progress.

The possession briefings and the site access permits on the three sites were recorded by me under the programme's procedures; the infrastructure owner audited the records twice and raised no findings.
The infrastructure owner's representative received my weekly progress report on each site, and the reports with the representative's comments are in the programme folder.
evidence.notes: Direct evidence of report preparation and delivery.

evidence.text: Equipment deliveries were tracked by me against the schedule in the delivery log, which marks the delivery queries I settled with the suppliers and the ones that needed the project manager's possession decision.
Each commissioning stage on the three sites ended with my hand-over note, countersigned by the commissioning engineer.
